15c3edf8-b487-48a2-ad71-9a8996f540d6.name: Weekly product read (Monday 07:00 UTC)
15c3edf8-b487-48a2-ad71-9a8996f540d6.actionPrompt:
Weekly product read. Outcome: the last 7 days of real human product usage are read, and each real finding is filed once as an insight with a recommended action.

First, find the flow named Product Analytics (list_loops) and read its description, section Setup. It says which product and platforms, which analytics tool and project, where the tracking plan is, how to leave out internal users, what a healthy feed looks like, what counts as critical and who to notify. If a line is empty, discover it from the analytics tool (its data schema and event list), note the guess in one line on the flow, and carry on.

Link every insight you file in this run to the flow with an in_loop relationship (source = flow, target = the insight). Check with list_relationships (source_id = flow id, type in_loop) and add any missing edge through update_objects edges.

Step 0, tool check: If no product analytics tool is connected (look at the tools you have and at list_integrations), read the flow's latest comment. If it does not already say so, post one line on the flow: "No product analytics tool is connected, so there is no usage read. Connect one under integrations." Then stop. File nothing and read no other source in its place.
Step 1, feed check: apply the healthy-feed rule from Setup. If it fails, post one line on the flow saying so, name the owner of tracking fixes from Setup, and stop. File nothing from a broken feed.
Step 2, read: activation (as defined in Setup), repeat use, drop-off per area of the tracking plan, new-feature adoption, and the mobile app if Setup lists one. Compare with the previous 4 weeks for trends, and split by platform and workspace size for patterns.
Step 3, friction and unmet needs: where people start something and do not finish, repeated failed attempts, features nobody touches, workarounds. Never read or store free text or personal data.
Step 4, file one insight per finding that changed or contradicts what the team believes. Body: what we saw, the count and period behind every number, who (type of user or workspace, never names), why it matters, one recommended action and who could take it, confidence, and what would raise it. Link it with informs to the feature or bet it concerns. Small samples are directions, not rates: always show the count.
Step 5, notify: if a finding meets the critical rule in Setup, post one short comment on the flow that mentions the person named under Notify (attention 4), with the finding, the count and the recommended action. Nothing else notifies a person.
Step 6, if a tracking gap blocked a question, file one insight tagged gap and mention the owner of tracking fixes from Setup.

Leave alone: events, dashboards and bets. If access to the analytics tool is refused for your account, say so once on the flow, name who can grant it, then stop. Silence when nothing moved. Plain words, no backticks, no em dashes.

f809d92f-b122-46f9-a3c2-776451105fdd.name: Owner heartbeat (Tue to Fri 07:56 UTC)
f809d92f-b122-46f9-a3c2-776451105fdd.actionPrompt:
Purpose: you are the accountable owner of the flow named Product Analytics (find it with list_loops). Load the skill drive-to-outcome first. Read the flow description, section Setup, first.

Each run: (1) read the flow's targets, compare each with its actual and today's pace, and write the gap in one line. (2) If this week's Monday read did not run or failed, run it now using the steps of the Weekly product read trigger (list_triggers, then get_trigger). (3) If no product analytics tool is connected, say so once on the flow (skip if the latest comment already says it) and stop. Otherwise check the analytics feed against the healthy-feed rule in Setup; if it fails, say so once on the flow and name the owner of tracking fixes from Setup. (4) Update the target Usage reads with the number of weekly reads completed this week (update_loop targets, keep every other field). (5) If a tracking gap blocks the read for the third check in a row, state the blocker once with the person who can clear it and stop polling. (6) Keep every pinned view tab fresh (get_loop lists them). On the first run after each Monday read, if a tab's data is older than that read, refresh it from the last 7 days.

Results tab: load the skill results-view-refresh first and follow it exactly. Call get_file on the tab's file, then update_file with edits that replace ONLY the JSON inside the script block with id results-data (pass if_match with the contentHash). Never touch the styles, the sources block or the render script. Keys: headline (a question), lead, banner, considered, items, monitor, recent, tiles, foot. items holds at most 3 Intelligence Briefs, each with type (one of the six output types), attention (Critical or Important), domains, title, found, why, evidence (2 to 4 linked items with the count of independent voices), interpretation, unknown (up to 3), next, reviewers, decision (one question) and actions (links to real objects). monitor is at most 5 single lines and recent at most 3. A brief goes on the view only if you have read its linked evidence and it would change what a person decides; never invent a finding. If nothing qualifies, set items to an empty list and write the considered line (items weighed, items set aside, last read). Replace last week's briefs, never append; carry forward a brief that still awaits a decision and say how long it has waited. Tracking gaps go on the view only when they block a question a person needs answered.

Lifecycle tab: refresh it as Setup describes, with human events only and internal users left out. Replace ONLY the JSON inside the script block with id lifecycle-data (get_file, then update_file with if_match). Keys: headline, lead, banner (state the snapshot date), define, stages (name, status Readable, Directional or Not readable yet, rows, weeks, note), needs, tiles, foot. Keep the count behind every rate, never show a rate from a sample under 10 without the count, and move a stage out of Not readable yet only when the data really exists. Once the person named in Setup confirms or changes the activation event, update define and drop the needs card.

Act inside your remit: read, file insights, never change events or dashboards, never send anything to a customer. Silence when fine: post one short comment on the flow only if something moved or a person is needed, at most one a day. Late start: nothing here is date-bound. Plain words, no backticks, no em dashes.

eccf1f5a-8103-489b-a8e1-f987fe05ec5e.name: Daily anomaly check (06:30 UTC)
eccf1f5a-8103-489b-a8e1-f987fe05ec5e.actionPrompt: Daily anomaly check. Outcome: yesterday's real human usage is compared with the usual level, and any anomaly is filed or escalated once. Find the flow named Product Analytics (list_loops) and read its description, section Setup. Step 0: if no product analytics tool is connected (look at the tools you have and at list_integrations), stay silent: the weekly read says so. Step 1: apply the healthy-feed rule from Setup. If the feed fails, stay silent unless the heartbeat has not already said so this week, then post one line on the flow and stop. Step 2: for each success event and main path in the tracking plan, compare yesterday with the median of the same weekday over the last 4 weeks. An anomaly is a drop or a spike of more than 50 percent with a count of 10 or more behind it, or a main path with no events. Ignore days with fewer than 10 events behind the baseline: say nothing. Step 3: for each anomaly, check whether an existing insight in the flow already covers it in the last 7 days; if so, stay silent. Otherwise file one insight (what we saw, yesterday against the usual level with counts, likely cause if the data shows one, one recommended action, confidence) linked to the flow with in_loop and to the feature or bet with informs. Step 4: if it meets the critical rule in Setup, post one short comment on the flow mentioning the person named under Notify (attention 4). Leave alone: events, dashboards and bets. If analytics access is refused, say so once on the flow and stop. Silence when nothing moved. Late start: if this session starts more than 6 hours after its scheduled time, do nothing. Plain words, no backticks, no em dashes.
